name: Google Drive
description: Search, read and edit files, Docs, Sheets and Slides with the Google Drive app connected to your ChatGPT account.

disclosure: Connect uses the Google Drive linked to your ChatGPT account, or opens ChatGPT to link one. Octopus reads your ChatGPT sign-in and keeps no Google token.
Tasks you connect to Google Drive can search and read your files, Docs, Sheets, Slides and comments, and pass what they read to their model.
Those tasks can also create, edit, upload, copy, share and delete files when their work calls for it.
Google Drive stays linked in ChatGPT: Disconnect in Octopus cannot unlink it. Choose, add or unlink Google accounts with Manage in ChatGPT.
